decision_rationale: The paper presents CodonMoE as a lightweight adapter that transforms DNA language models into RNA analyzers, not a new generative model. It does describe large-scale genomic language models trained on vast biological sequence data, so foundation-model evidence is present.
evidence_snippet: "a lightweight adapter that transforms DNA language models into effective RNA analyzers without RNA-specific pretraining"; "GLMs are large-scale language models trained on vast amounts of biological sequence data"; "Four RNA prediction tasks"
